meaning:
1) looking, appearance, seeing, sight
1a) seeing
1b) appearance
1c) sight, spectacle

elsewhere.note: She called the name of Yahweh who spoke to her, “You are a God who sees,” for she said, “Have I even stayed alive after seeing him?”
He sent, and brought him in. Now he was ruddy, with a handsome face and good appearance. Yahweh said, “Arise! Anoint him, for this is he.”
The eye of him who sees me will see me no more. Your eyes will be on me, but I will not be.
I will throw abominable filth on you, and make you vile, and will set you a spectacle.
